# Scenario: proxies validation soft-fails and leaves prior compose/proxy alone
# (proxy XOR proxies; empty proxies; duplicate inbound domain / port).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: valid singular proxy baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# proxy and proxies are mutually exclusive
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.proxy-and-proxies.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: set both proxy and proxies'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'proxy and proxies are mutually exclusive'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# empty proxies rejected
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.proxies-empty.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: empty proxies'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'proxies must not be empty'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# duplicate inbound domain across routes
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.dup-domain.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: duplicate domain'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'already used by project'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

# duplicate inbound port across projects
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.dup-port.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: duplicate inbound port'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'already used by project'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
stdout 'OK'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.proxy-and-proxies.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    proxies:
      - inbound:
          port: 9998
        target:
          service:
            name: web
            port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.proxies-empty.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxies: []
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.dup-domain.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxies:
      - inbound:
          domain-name: shop.apinfra.test
        target:
          service:
            name: web
            port: 80
        config:
          cert-issue-type: none
      - inbound:
          domain-name: shop.apinfra.test
        target:
          service:
            name: web
            port: 80
        config:
          cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.dup-port.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-other
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-other/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OTHER"]

-- .env --
